description.value: Grizzly Flatbread is a Neapolitan-style pizza and flatbread restaurant in Ladner, BC, known for hand-tossed dough made with imported Italian 00 flour cooked in an open-flame stone hearth oven. The menu features meat and vegetarian/vegan pizzas, flatbreads, salads, and sides, with both in-house dining and online ordering for pickup or delivery. A welcoming neighbourhood spot with a casual atmosphere, it sits along Ladner Trunk Road in the Tsawwassen/Ladner area of Metro Vancouver.
